message.name: Awake
message.summary: Awake is called when an enabled script instance is being loaded.

message.name: OnEnable
message.summary: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

message.name: Start
message.summary: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods are called the first time.

message.name: FixedUpdate
message.summary: Frame-rate independent MonoBehaviour.FixedUpdate message for physics calculations.

message.name: Update
message.summary: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

message.name: LateUpdate
message.summary: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled, after all Update functions have been called.

message.name: OnDisable
message.summary: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled or inactive.

message.name: OnDestroy
message.summary: Destroying the attached Behaviour will result in the game or Scene receiving OnDestroy.

message.name: OnTriggerEnter
message.summary: When a GameObject collides with another GameObject, Unity calls OnTriggerEnter.

parameter.name: other
parameter.description: The other Collider involved in this collision.

message.name: OnTriggerStay
message.summary: OnTriggerStay is called almost all the frames for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

message.name: OnTriggerExit
message.summary: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

message.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
message.summary: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

message.name: OnTriggerStay2D
message.summary: Sent each frame where another object is within a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

message.name: OnTriggerExit2D
message.summary: Sent when another object leaves a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

message.name: OnCollisionEnter
message.summary: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

message.name: OnCollisionStay
message.summary: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching rigidbody/collider.

message.name: OnCollisionExit
message.summary: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

message.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
message.summary: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

message.name: OnCollisionStay2D
message.summary: Sent each frame where a collider on another object is touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

message.name: OnCollisionExit2D
message.summary: Sent when a collider on another object stops touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

message.name: OnControllerColliderHit
message.summary: OnControllerColliderHit is called when the controller hits a collider while performing a Move.

message.name: OnJointBreak
message.summary: Called when a joint attached to the same game object broke.

message.name: OnJointBreak2D
message.summary: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same game object breaks.

message.name: OnGUI
message.summary: OnGUI is called for rendering and handling GUI events.

message.name: OnDrawGizmos
message.summary: Implement OnDrawGizmos if you want to draw gizmos that are also pickable and always drawn.

message.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
message.summary: Implement OnDrawGizmosSelected to draw a gizmo if the object is selected.

message.name: OnValidate
message.summary: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

message.name: Reset
message.summary: Reset to default values.

message.name: OnApplicationFocus
message.summary: Sent to all GameObjects when the player gets or loses focus.

message.name: OnApplicationPause
message.summary: Sent to all GameObjects when the application pauses.

message.name: OnApplicationQuit
message.summary: Sent to all game objects before the application quits.

message.name: OnAnimatorIK
message.summary: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

message.name: OnAnimatorMove
message.summary: Callback for processing animation movements for modifying root motion.

message.name: OnAudioFilterRead
message.summary: If OnAudioFilterRead is implemented, Unity will insert a custom filter into the audio DSP chain.

message.name: OnBecameVisible
message.summary: OnBecameVisible is called when the renderer became visible by any camera.

message.name: OnBecameInvisible
message.summary: OnBecameInvisible is called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

message.name: OnWillRenderObject
message.summary: OnWillRenderObject is called for each camera if the object is visible and not a UI element.

message.name: OnPreCull
message.summary: OnPreCull is called before a camera culls the scene.

message.name: OnPreRender
message.summary: OnPreRender is called before a camera starts rendering the scene.

message.name: OnPostRender
message.summary: OnPostRender is called after a camera finishes rendering the scene.

message.name: OnRenderObject
message.summary: OnRenderObject is called after camera has rendered the Scene.

message.name: OnRenderImage
message.summary: OnRenderImage is called after all rendering is complete to render image.

message.name: OnParticleCollision
message.summary: OnParticleCollision is called when a particle hits a collider.

message.name: OnParticleTrigger
message.summary: OnParticleTrigger is called when any particles in a Particle System meet the conditions in the trigger module.

message.name: OnParticleSystemStopped
message.summary: OnParticleSystemStopped is called when all particles in the system have died.

message.name: OnMouseDown
message.summary: OnMouseDown is called when the user has pressed the mouse button while over the Collider.

message.name: OnMouseDrag
message.summary: OnMouseDrag is called when the user has clicked on a Collider and is still holding down the mouse.

message.name: OnMouseEnter
message.summary: Called when the mouse enters the Collider.

message.name: OnMouseExit
message.summary: Called when the mouse is not any longer over the Collider.

message.name: OnMouseOver
message.summary: Called every frame while the mouse is over the Collider.

message.name: OnMouseUp
message.summary: OnMouseUp is called when the user has released the mouse button.

message.name: OnMouseUpAsButton
message.summary: OnMouseUpAsButton is only called when the mouse is released over the same Collider as it was pressed on.

message.name: OnTransformChildrenChanged
message.summary: Called when the list of children of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

message.name: OnTransformParentChanged
message.summary: Called when the parent property of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

message.name: OnBeforeTransformParentChanged
message.summary: Called just before the parent property of the transform is about to change.

message.name: OnRectTransformDimensionsChange
message.summary: This callback is called if any associated RectTransform has its dimensions changed.

message.name: Awake
message.summary: This function is called when the ScriptableObject script is started.

message.name: OnEnable
message.summary: This function is called when the object is loaded.

message.name: OnDisable
message.summary: This function is called when the scriptable object goes out of scope.

message.name: OnDestroy
message.summary: This function is called when the scriptable object will be destroyed.

message.name: OnValidate
message.summary: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

message.name: Reset
message.summary: Reset to default values.

message.name: OnStateEnter
message.summary: Called on the first Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

message.name: OnStateUpdate
message.summary: Called on each Update frame between OnStateEnter and OnStateExit callbacks.

message.name: OnStateExit
message.summary: Called on the last Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

message.name: OnStateMove
message.summary: Called right after Animator.OnAnimatorMove.

message.name: OnStateIK
message.summary: Called right after Animator.OnAnimatorIK.

message.name: OnStateMachineEnter
message.summary: Called when a transition starts and the state machine starts to evaluate this state machine.

message.name: OnStateMachineExit
message.summary: Called when a transition ends and the state machine finishes evaluating this state machine.

message.name: Awake
message.summary: Awake is called when the UIBehaviour instance is being loaded.

message.name: OnEnable
message.summary: Called when the UI object becomes enabled and active.

message.name: Start
message.summary: Called before the first frame update.

message.name: OnDisable
message.summary: Called when the UI object becomes disabled.

message.name: OnDestroy
message.summary: Called when the UI object is destroyed.

message.name: OnValidate
message.summary: Editor-only callback when serialized values change.

message.name: Reset
message.summary: Reset to default values.

message.name: OnRectTransformDimensionsChange
message.summary: Called when the dimensions of an associated RectTransform change.

message.name: OnDidApplyAnimationProperties
message.summary: Callback when animation clips modify RectTransform/UI properties.

message.name: OnCanvasGroupChanged
message.summary: Called when the CanvasGroup state changes.

message.name: OnCanvasHierarchyChanged
message.summary: Called when the parent Canvas changes.

message.name: OnTransformParentChanged
message.summary: Called when the Transform parent changes.

message.name: OnBeforeTransformParentChanged
message.summary: Called before the Transform parent changes.

message.name: Awake
message.summary: Called when the Editor object is created.

message.name: OnEnable
message.summary: Called when the Editor object becomes active.

message.name: OnDisable
message.summary: Called when the Editor object becomes inactive.

message.name: OnDestroy
message.summary: Called when the Editor object is destroyed.

message.name: OnInspectorGUI
message.summary: Implement this function to make a custom inspector.

message.name: OnSceneGUI
message.summary: Enables the Editor to handle an event in the Scene view.

message.name: CreateInspectorGUI
message.summary: Implement this method to make a custom UIElements inspector.

message.name: HasPreviewGUI
message.summary: Override this method in subclasses if the editor has a custom preview.

message.name: OnPreviewGUI
message.summary: Implement to create your own custom preview for the preview area of the inspector.

message.name: OnInteractivePreviewGUI
message.summary: Implement to create your own interactive custom preview.

message.name: RequiresConstantRepaint
message.summary: Checks if this editor requires constant repainting in its inspector.

message.name: Awake
message.summary: Called as the new window is opened.

message.name: OnEnable
message.summary: Called when the window is loaded.

message.name: OnDisable
message.summary: Called when the window is closed or disabled.

message.name: OnDestroy
message.summary: OnDestroy is called to close the EditorWindow window.

message.name: OnGUI
message.summary: Implement your own Editor GUI here.

message.name: CreateGUI
message.summary: CreateGUI is called when the EditorWindow's root VisualElement is ready to be populated.

message.name: Update
message.summary: Called 100 times per second on all visible windows.

message.name: OnInspectorUpdate
message.summary: OnInspectorUpdate is called at 10 frames per second to give the inspector a chance to update.

message.name: OnSelectionChange
message.summary: Called whenever the selection has changed.

message.name: OnHierarchyChange
message.summary: Handler for message that is sent when an object or group of objects in the hierarchy changes.

message.name: OnProjectChange
message.summary: Handler for message that is sent whenever the state of the project changes.

message.name: OnFocus
message.summary: Called when the window gets keyboard focus.

message.name: OnLostFocus
message.summary: Called when the window loses keyboard focus.

message.name: OnBecameVisible
message.summary: Called after the window is added to a container view and becomes visible.

message.name: OnBecameInvisible
message.summary: Called before the window is removed or hidden.

message.name: OnGUI
message.summary: Override this method to make your own IMGUI based GUI for the property.

message.name: GetPropertyHeight
message.summary: Override this method to specify how tall the GUI for this field is in pixels.

message.name: CreatePropertyGUI
message.summary: Override this method to make your own UI Toolkit based GUI for the property.

message.name: OnPreprocessTexture
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before a texture imports.

message.name: OnPostprocessTexture
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when a texture asset has finished importing.

message.name: OnPreprocessModel
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before a model (.fbx, .obj, etc.) is imported.

message.name: OnPostprocessModel
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when a 3D model has finished importing.

message.name: OnPreprocessAudio
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before an audio clip is imported.

message.name: OnPostprocessAudio
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when an audio clip has finished importing.

message.name: OnPreprocessAsset
message.summary: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before any asset is imported.

message.name: OnPostprocessAllAssets
message.summary: This is called after importing of any number of assets is complete.

message.name: OnImportAsset
message.summary: This method must be overridden by the derived class and is called by the Asset pipeline to import files.

message.name: OnNetworkSpawn
message.summary: Gets called when the NetworkObject is spawned on the network.

message.name: OnNetworkDespawn
message.summary: Gets called when the NetworkObject is despawned.

message.name: OnGainedOwnership
message.summary: Called when the local client gains ownership of the NetworkObject.

message.name: OnLostOwnership
message.summary: Called when the local client loses ownership of the NetworkObject.
